summary: Create micro-project: scheduled Slack-thread transcription to Confluence with granular RBAC and thread lifecycle
description:
Issue summary:
We need a lightweight, team-scoped Jira/Confluence/Slack micro-project for the Research Intern Sprints pod that provisions: a dedicated Confluence space, a Slack channel template, and an automation pipeline that nightly transcribes pinned Slack threads into a sprint page in Confluence. The pipeline must respect granular write permissions (only sprint leads can edit transcriptions), include an approval gating step for public posts, and automatically archive Slack threads older than 90 days.

Impact:
Research interns and their mentors currently lose contextual knowledge because post-meeting Slack threads are ephemeral. This causes repeated questions in office hours and duplicate effort when historical decisions are not captured. The request aims to reduce repetitive syncs and make sprint notes discoverable for onboarding. Estimated ~20 users (interns + mentors) initially.

Request details / Business justification:
- Create a Confluence space under the Research pod with page template "Sprint Thread Archive".
- Create a Slack channel template #research-sprint-<id> and a provisioning flow to create ephemeral channels tied to a Confluence page.
- Implement a scheduled automation (runs nightly at 02:00 UTC) that: 1) finds threads in the channel flagged with a :pin: or with the tag "sprint-summary"; 2) runs a hosted ASR+NLP transcription or uses an approved third-party transcription app; 3) writes a formatted summary to the Confluence sprint page; 4) sets page permissions so only the sprint leads group can edit.
- Add RBAC groups: research-interns-read, research-interns-edit, research-sprint-leads (edit approval).
- Add a consent/approval toggle so that threads marked "public" require one approval by sprint-leads before being published to Confluence.
- Archive Slack threads and auto-close ephemeral channels after 120 days with optional renewal.

Acceptance criteria (how we'll know it's done):
- Confluence space exists and uses the provided template.
- New sprint Slack channel can be created via the provisioning flow and is linked to the corresponding Confluence page.
- Nightly automation runs and posts a draft transcription to the Confluence sprint page with metadata (source channel, thread URL, timestamp).
- Only members of research-sprint-leads can publish edits; interns can comment but not overwrite.
- Public-post approval flow requires one approval from sprint-leads before the Confluence page is published to the wider Research space.
- Thread archival policy is enforced and recorded in the runbook.

Requested timeline:
- Target: pilot for next intern cohort. Prefer delivery in 3 weeks from approval (pilot start date 2026-03-25).

Steps to provision (proposed):
1) Create Confluence space + page template (product ops).
2) Create Slack channel provisioning app or use existing channel template automation (DevOps/SRE).
3) Implement nightly worker: Lambda or internal automation job that calls Slack API, transcription service, and Confluence API (Automation team).
4) Create RBAC groups in Okta/SCIM and map to Confluence permissions (Security/Identity).
5) Add approval workflow (Slack modal or Confluence draft + approver notification).
6) Add archival job and notify channel owners 14 days before closure.

Attachments / examples provided by reporter:
- Example thread URL: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1679999999000200
- Draft page template content uploaded to Reporter Google Drive (link shared in private).
acceptance_criteria: Confluence space 'Research - Sprint Archives' created with 'Sprint Thread Archive' template
Channel provisioning flow creates #research-sprint-<id> and links to a Confluence draft page
Nightly automation posts draft transcriptions with metadata and source links
Only 'research-sprint-leads' have edit/publish rights on sprint pages
Approval gating required to publish public transcriptions
Thread archival lifecycle enforces 90-day archival and 120-day channel closure with notifications

Provision Slack channel template and create provisioning flow
Build nightly automation job (Slack -> Transcription -> Confluence)

Implement approver modal and Confluence draft publish flow
Implement archival job and owner notification workflow
comments: Dana Liu (Reporter) 2026-03-01: Adding initial request and links to examples. Happy to meet with automation team to walk through thread selection heuristics.

Elena Rodriguez (Assignee) 2026-03-02: Triage acknowledgement - assigning to Platform Automation team. Need clarification on allowed transcription providers (in-house vs third-party) and whether PII redaction is required.

Security (Samir Khatri) 2026-03-02: Flagging PII/PHI considerations. If third-party transcription is used we need a DPA or a privacy-preserving transform. Also recommend default redaction of usernames and email addresses in public transcriptions.

Dana Liu 2026-03-02: Priority is to keep everything internal to Redwood-managed services if possible. If not, we'll work with Legal to approve a vendor for the pilot. For now assume redaction required for public posts.

Platform Automation (Rachel Kim) 2026-03-02: Quick check: do we want to store full thread transcripts in Confluence or only a summarized digest? Storing full transcripts will increase space and retention compliance scope.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-02 - Platform Automation: Reviewed existing channel template automation in repo infra/slack/channel-provisioner. Reusable hooks exist to attach metadata to a Confluence page. Estimated 2-3 days to wire up provisioning flow.

2026-03-02 - Security: Okta groups research-interns-read/edit and research-sprint-leads can be created via existing SCIM connector. Will coordinate with Identity to set group lifecycle TTLs for temporary interns.

2026-03-02 - Legal: Will require vendor questionnaire if using external ASR. For pilot, prefer internal summarization using existing in-house summarizer (model-hosted on Redwood Dedicated) to avoid third-party data flow.
2026-03-02 - Compliance: Need to add the Confluence space to retention policy 'intern-sprint-90d' if transcriptions are PII-free. Otherwise flag for longer retention and DPA controls.
resolution: Pending - next steps: Platform Automation to prototype provisioning hook (ETA 2026-03-08), Security to confirm redaction defaults (ETA 2026-03-05), Legal to confirm vendor constraints if needed. Schedule kickoff meeting after triage to align owners.
